violations.text: Beans, dried fruits, nuts, cheeses packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026
The handsink, located in the ware washing area, is lacking hot water. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

The walls (lower half) in the walk-in cooler are constructed of drywall. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Establishment does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. Establishment is to install hand sink. Establishment is not approved for any food preparation or re-packaging until hand sink is installed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026

Cut fruit was observed from an unapproved source. Per PIC, fruit was cut from home. Fruit was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

Raw animal foods eggs were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods fruit in the 2 door reach-in. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

Cheese was observed held between 48-50 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All cheese in walk-in cooler was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in walk-in cooler until it is able to hold an ambient temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

Various food products packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Cheese was observed with no labels. Establishment is to only accept food deliveries that have labels. Per PIC, company will be contacted about adding labels to product. Cheese in display case was embargoed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

The door to the outside, located in the retail area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Rat burrows were observed outside by the refuse area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to continue to work with pest control to eliminate pests. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026
Various food was observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026
Walk-in cooler was observed holding an ambient temperature of 45 DF. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

Establishments 3-bay sink was observed with no plumbing, and non-operational. Establishment is to have 3-bay sink plumbed in order to wash, rinse, and sanitized food contact surfaces/utensils. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in fans have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

The outside dumpster/refuse area was observed with an accumulation of trash/debris. Per PIC, trash will be removed tomorrow morning. Refuse areas must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

The floor under the shelves in the retail area have an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026
The floor in front of the walk-in cooler area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2026

Produce walk-in cooler was not in good repair. At time of inspection, ambient was 49 degrees Fahrenheit. No TCS foods observed. PIC informed that no TCS foods can be stored in unit until it reaches 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the fans in the walk-in cooler have an accumulation of dust, dirt, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/09/2024
